items.source: Properties in form key=value that should be added to the Spring Environment before the test runs.
items.translation: 要在测试运行之前添加到 Spring Environment 的 form key=value 格式的属性。

items.source: Auto-configuration exclusions that should be applied for this test.
items.translation: 应应用于此测试的自动配置排除项。

items.source:
A set of exclude filters which can be used to filter beans that would otherwise be
added to the application context.
items.translation: 一组排除过滤器，可用于过滤本应添加到应用上下文的 Bean。

items.source:
A set of include filters which can be used to add otherwise filtered beans to the
application context.
items.translation: 一组包含过滤器，可用于将其他过滤器排除的 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中。

items.source: If you are looking to load your full application configuration, but use an embedded database, you should consider @SpringBootTest combined with @AutoConfigureTestDatabase rather than this annotation.
items.translation: 如果您希望加载完整的应用程序配置，但使用嵌入式数据库，则应考虑将 @SpringBootTest 与 @AutoConfigureTestDatabase 结合使用，而不是使用此注解。

items.source: By default, tests annotated with @DataJdbcTest are transactional and roll back at the end of each test. They also use an embedded in-memory database (replacing any explicit or usually auto-configured DataSource). The @AutoConfigureTestDatabase annotation can be used to override these settings.
items.translation: 默认情况下，带有 @DataJdbcTest 注解的测试是事务性的，并在每个测试结束时回滚。它们还使用嵌入式内存数据库（替换任何显式或通常自动配置的 DataSource）。可以使用 @AutoConfigureTestDatabase 注解来覆盖这些设置。

items.source: Using this annotation only enables auto-configuration that is relevant to Data JDBC tests. Similarly, component scanning is limited to JDBC repositories and entities (@Table), as well as beans that implement AbstractJdbcConfiguration.
items.translation: 仅使用此注解可启用与 Data JDBC 测试相关的自动配置。同样，组件扫描仅限于 JDBC 仓库和实体（`@Table`），以及实现 `AbstractJdbcConfiguration` 的 Bean。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication. By default, only AbstractJdbcConfiguration beans are included.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能与@SpringBootApplication一起。默认情况下，仅包含AbstractJdbcConfiguration 类型的 Bean。

items.source: When using JUnit 4, this annotation should be used in combination with @RunWith(SpringRunner.class).
items.translation: 在使用 JUnit 4 时，此注解应与 @RunWith(SpringRunner.class) 结合使用。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能与 @SpringBootApplication。

items.source: if default filters should be used
items.translation: 如果应使用默认过滤器
